What training or education is needed?
This varies in computer-land depending on what you are building.

My degree is in “Music Education” 👀
If you are doing graphic design or web development (what I do), you may be able to learn on your own or attend a 3-6 month training school.
If you are building something really complicated like Google or a video game, then you probably need a lot more training.
